# Ntombii Tech

> Newcastle-born digital studio building mobile-first websites, brand systems, print, signage and corporate gifts for Northern KZN businesses and beyond.

Ntombii Tech is a design and development studio based in Newcastle, KwaZulu-Natal. We build production websites, brand identities, graphic design, printing, signage, ink & toner supply and corporate gifts for SMEs, NGOs and growing African brands.

- [Home](/): Studio overview, capabilities and selected work.

- [About](/about): Team, story and how we work.
- [Process](/process): Our four-step delivery process.
- [Contact](/contact): Start a project or get a quote on WhatsApp.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on web, branding and local business growth.
- [Areas Served](/areas): Northern KZN towns we work with.

## Services

- [Branding](/services/branding): Logo, identity systems and brand guidelines.
- [Graphic Design](/services/graphic-design): Marketing collateral, social and pitch decks.
- [Printing](/services/printing): Business cards, flyers, banners and large-format print.
- [Ink & Toner](/services/ink-toner): Genuine and compatible cartridges, delivered.
- [Signage](/services/signage): Shopfront, vehicle and event signage.
- [Corporate Gifts](/services/corporate-gifts): Branded gifts and merchandise.
